tools.name: anomaly_check_availability
tools.description: List open times for a Physician Health Review with Anomaly Health (30 min $249, 60 min $349). Use after the user decides to talk to a real doctor. Pass the user's timezone to get local times alongside UTC. Available in all US states.

tools.name: anomaly_book_session
tools.description: Book a Physician Health Review with Anomaly Health (30 min $249, 60 min $349). Booking holds the slot; the result includes a payment link, and the session is confirmed once paid. Tell the user the price before booking. Requires a start time from anomaly_check_availability. Available in all US states

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: anomaly_about_care, anomaly_check_availability · Private data: anomaly_health_memory · Public sink: anomaly_health_memory, anomaly_book_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: anomaly_about_care, anomaly_check_availability · Private data: anomaly_health_memory · Public sink: anomaly_health_memory, anomaly_book_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
